33486-songs-of-the-silent-world-and-othe.title: _And Other Poems_
33486-songs-of-the-silent-world-and-othe.creator: Unknown
33486-songs-of-the-silent-world-and-othe.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The Songs of Seventy Years Birthday Verses A Tribute To O. Whose shall the Welcome be? Exeat George Eliot Her Jury VI. (Matins.) An Acknowledgment Hymn Answered Westward Three Friends A New Friend An Etching To my Father The Gates Between A Prayer. SONGS OF THE SILENT WORLD. There _is_ no vacant chair. The loving meet-- A group unbroken--smitten, who knows how? One sitteth silent only, in his usual seat; We gave him once that freedom.

arxiv-2207-03305.title: Multimodal E-Commerce Product Classification Using Hierarchical Fusion PubID: pubid: 978-1-6654- 9653-7/22/$31.00 © 2022 IEEE
arxiv-2207-03305.creator: Tsegaye Misikir Tashu 1 3 , Sara Fattouh 1 , Péter Kiss 1 and Tomáš Horváth 1 2
arxiv-2207-03305.description: Abstract In this work, we present a multi-modal model for commercial product classification, that combines features extracted by multiple neural network models from textual (CamemBERT and FlauBERT) and visual data (SE-ResNeXt-50), using simple fusion techniques. The proposed method significantly outperformed the performance of the unimodal models, as well as the reported performance of similar models on our specific task.

arxiv-2303-10681.title: Generative Adversarial Classification Network with Application to Network Traffic Classification
arxiv-2303-10681.creator: Rozhina Ghanavi 1 , Ben Liang 1 , Ali Tizghadam 2
arxiv-2303-10681.description: Abstract Large datasets in machine learning often contain missing data, which necessitates the imputation of missing data values. In this work, we are motivated by network traffic classification, where traditional data imputation methods do not perform well. We recognize that no existing method directly accounts for classification accuracy during data imputation.

arxiv-2401-09039.title: Hairy Reissner-Nordstrom Black Holes with Asymmetric Vacua
arxiv-2401-09039.creator: Xiao Yan Chew, Dong-han Yeom
arxiv-2401-09039.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Xiao Yan Chew, Dong-han Yeom. We minimally coupled a scalar potential V ⁡ ( ϕ ) V(\phi) with asymmetric vacua to the Einstein gravity to numerically construct the hairy Reissner-Nordstrom black hole (RNBH) as a direct generalization of RNBHs to possess scalar hair. By fixing the electric charge to mass ratio q q , a branch of hairy RNBHs bifurcates from the RNBH when the scalar field ϕ H \phi_{H} is non-trivial at the horizon.

arxiv-2508-12329.title: Local constancy of reduction type and related invariants for curves in p p -adic families
arxiv-2508-12329.creator: Jakab Schrettner
arxiv-2508-12329.description: Abstract We investigate the behaviour of the reduction type and related invariants of curves in families of curves over a discretely valued field. By a family, we will mean a set of curves obtained by perturbing the coefficients of the defining equations.

pmc-11570995.title: In-silico modelling of insulin secretion and pancreatic beta-cell function for clinical applications: is it worth the effort?
pmc-11570995.creator: Andrea Tura, Christian Göbl, Mohamed El-Tanani, Manfredi Rizzo
pmc-11570995.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Among the different metabolic processes addressed by such models, one relevant is insulin secretion and pancreatic beta-cell function. Indeed, although it is currently known that several factors affect glucose homeostasis (5), the impairment in insulin secretion/beta-cell function, in addition to that of insulin sensitivity, are typically the most important determinants of glycemic control deterioration and possible development of type 2 diabetes. In this opinion article, we will provide considerations about in-silico modelling of beta-cell function.

pmc-12829005.title: TRIM2 exacerbates the advancement of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis by modulating β-catenin and endoplasmic reticulum stress
pmc-12829005.creator: Yong Zhang, Di Jiang, Ganjuan Nie, Zhanping Lei, Jie Ling, Mi Tang, Yanmei Hu, Hengzhong Yi
pmc-12829005.description: BackgroundThe progression of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is closely associated with endoplasmic reticulum stress (ERS). However, its precise regulatory mechanism has not been fully elucidated. As an E3 ubiquitin ligase, the biological function of TRIM2 in IPF and its regulatory role in ERS remain unexplored.

pmc-13183919.title: ResTransUNet: a dual-encoder hybrid network for automated liver segmentation in CT scans
pmc-13183919.creator: Yuan Wang
pmc-13183919.description: Precise delineation of the liver is essential for effective diagnosis and treatment planning in hepatocellular carcinoma, yet current clinical practices rely heavily on manual annotation, which is both inefficient and susceptible to human error. In this work, we propose a fully automated segmentation framework, termed ResTransUNet, that leverages the complementary strengths of convolutional operations and self-attention mechanisms.

pmc-13253245.title: A real-time ripeness detection model for tomatoes in complex greenhouse environments
pmc-13253245.creator: Bo Cheng, Xuli Wu, Hao Du, Xiangying Qi, Junhui Wu, Shumei Zhao
pmc-13253245.description: Timely harvesting of fresh tomatoes is urgently needed. To address this issue, this study proposes DDC-YOLOv11n, a model suitable for real-time detection of tomato ripeness in complex greenhouse environments. A Zero-DCE adaptive enhancement module is first deployed at the input stage to restore and enhance the true color and texture details of the images.
